headline: TAZARA revival promises stronger Tanzania-China ties and a new trade lifeline across Africa
summary: The planned TAZARA revitalisation is expected to raise freight capacity twelvefold and shorten transport times across Eastern, Central and Southern Africa. The project is a partnership between Tanzania, Zambia and China, marking 50 years of operations.
why: TAZARA is a cross-border railway linking Tanzania and Zambia, and freight capacity affects mining and trade logistics for landlocked Zambia.
